scope: host-only camera sensor-clock ownership quarantine regression

wrong_fixture_control.fixture: pinned original source tree supplied as derived root

shutdown_quarantine_observed_behavior.unknown_owner_policy: core-wide retention when any sensor clock owner is unknown
shutdown_quarantine_observed_behavior.cleanup: marks probed sensors reboot=true under mutex_reboot; no front-stop callback
shutdown_quarantine_observed_behavior.platform_shutdown: returns before sensor-thread deinit and CIS work cancellation
shutdown_quarantine_observed_behavior.healthy_peer: retained when another sensor in the camera core is unknown
shutdown_quarantine_observed_behavior.queued_start_worker: before the reboot branch, scans current and peer sensor UNKNOWN state under the current sensor reboot mutex; on observed uncertainty it returns -EUCLEAN without sensor-start or CSI stream-off
shutdown_quarantine_observed_behavior.repeat_calls: idempotent in the extracted host fixture

limits: The UNKNOWN preflight is not serialized with runtime-PM latching; a concurrent state transition can race the scan.
The worker skips the reboot branch's CSI stop only if it observes UNKNOWN before that branch; work already past the guard is not quiesced.
Kernel mutexes, front-stop, CSI calls, work cancellation, sensor-thread deinit, clocks, VFS/V4L2/VB2 lifetime calls are host shims or static checks.
Already-running asynchronous work, physical DMA/clock state, parent-device teardown, system power removal, and hardware acceptance remain unproven.
non_actions: No kernel build or source-tree mutation.
No phone, camera, firmware, stream, module-load, reboot, or device operation.
No hardware acceptance or deploy authorization.
